newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to enforce Sunday ban on trucks.
newsitem.headline: France to enforce Sunday ban on trucks.

text.p: France will this week begin enforcing a ban on trucks driving on Sundays and bank holidays, the transport ministry said on Monday.
The ban will apply to trucks weighing over 7.5 tonnes from Saturday 10 p.m. to 10 p.m. Monday as Easter Monday is a bank holiday. Offenders face a 900-franc ($160) fine.

French and foreign trucks had until now been allowed to drive on Sundays if they were returning home from abroad. Truckers won the extension of the ban after a strike last year, thus ensuring they would get at least one day off a week.
